cross_source_rules: Reconcile by vendor/operator, offering, source_record_id, jurisdiction, access scope and source date. Identical region tokens across different vendors are not identity keys.
Canonical layers, derived views, product matrices, marketing totals, legacy files, and quarantine are different dataset roles. Derived views must remain subsets and excluded from additive counts.
Keep competing source assertions with source dates and an explicit unresolved-conflict field. Missing listing is not proof of retirement.
Cloud region, AZ, resource pool, model endpoint, model deployment, GPU availability, training cluster, physical facility, fiber system and IX membership are different units.
Model developer, API operator, host/colocation operator, network operator, legal entity and brand/domain require explicit relationship evidence.
Record source publication/update and retrieval dates separately. Mark indexed snippets and failed direct retrieval explicitly; retrieval does not refresh an old publication.
Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan remain distinct jurisdiction values. Overseas offerings need their own geography and access scope.
Coordinates remain null until supported; cloud city centroids and network-derived locations are not facility coordinates. Verify source CRS before WGS84 serialization.
Do not infer model execution geography from API edge location, provider headquarters, a region-token convention, or the location of its model developer.
